question.text: Which of the following statement is not correct?

options.text: Amylopectin is a branched polymer of $\alpha$ - glucose.
Cellulose is a linear polymer of $\beta$-glucose.
Glycogen is the food reserve of plants.
All proteins are polymers of $\alpha$ - amino acids.

solution.text: Glycogen is called animal starch and is found in all animal cells. It constitutes the reserve food material.
